source.name: ThermoMPNN FireProt PDB Dataset
source.homologue_free_provenance: ThermoMPNN authors' MMseqs2 25-percent homology exclusion relative to their Megascale set, not independent Boltz2 contamination audit.

selection.procedure: Filter single canonical mutations whose positions match a 30..400-aa all-canonical PDB WT sequence with DOI and UniProt+InterPro+chain; dedupe variant by (position,WT,ALT), select first DOI/experiment lexicographically; sort eligible PDBs by decreasing variant count and PDB name; greedily choose 10 with disjoint InterPro family IDs and UniProt; choose 20 variants/PDB with SHA256(seed|pdb|(position,WT,ALT)) sorted; no outcome features.

units_and_sign.source_reported_ddG_definition: mutant-minus-WT in dataset as labeled by curators
units_and_sign.predeclared_sign_orientation_hypothesis: ThermoMPNN usage convention: negative ΔΔG is stabilizing, so candidate mapping to positive-stabilizing is label_s2 = -ddG_source; MUST be verified against original curated experiment/definitions before scoring.

requirements: same provider version and settings for WT and 200 mutants
all 210 structural confidence receipts pinned before any label unlock
no new Rowan credits, unless separately preapproved
no training, recalibration, or heldout adjustment
